title: 台北 101~Taipei 101
focus: 以巨柱合成斷面、外伸桁架力偶、台北盆地基樁與施工期臨時結構的實際數字，深化台北 101 的結構檢核~Deepening Taipei 101 checks with real numbers on composite mega-columns, outrigger couples, basin piles and construction-stage temporary works
summary: 在既有 24 步的系統觀念之上，本段改用數字與證據深入台北 101：三級風力準則與角隅修形、八支巨柱的力偶與合成斷面容量、SM570M 厚板焊接、380 支岩盤嵌入基樁、2002 年地震塔吊墜落的臨時結構教訓、填充混凝土驗收、兩級地震性能，以及阻尼器事件紀錄與帷幕牆維護。~Building on the existing 24 system-level steps, this extension goes into Taipei 101 with numbers and evidence: three-tier wind criteria and corner notches, the eight-mega-column couple and composite capacity, SM570M thick-plate welding, 380 rock-socketed piles, temporary-works lessons from the 2002 crane collapse, infill-concrete acceptance, two-level seismic performance, damper event records and curtain-wall upkeep.

units.anchor: 角隅鋸齒缺角~Sawtooth corner notches
units.title: 三級風力準則與角隅修形~Three-tier wind criteria and corner shaping
units.mechanism: 台北 101 的風工程不是單一設計風速，而是三組回歸期各管一件事：約半年回歸期檢核居住舒適度、50 年回歸期檢核變位、100 年回歸期檢核構材強度。風洞試驗後，建築在四個角隅做出鋸齒狀缺角，讓氣流在角部提早分離並打亂整齊的渦流脫落，使橫風向反應明顯降低。角隅修形同時改變帷幕牆的局部風壓分布，因此構架、阻尼器與外牆三方都必須使用同一份風洞資料，而不是各自套用規範公式。~Taipei 101's wind engineering is not one design wind speed but three return periods, each governing a different check: roughly a half-year event for occupant comfort, a 50-year event for drift and a 100-year event for member strength. After wind-tunnel testing, the four corners were given sawtooth notches that trigger early flow separation and break up organised vortex shedding, clearly reducing across-wind response. Corner shaping also changes local cladding pressures, so the frame, damper and façade teams must all work from the same wind-tunnel dataset rather than each applying code formulas on their own.
units.model: 以均布等效風壓估計基底彎矩 M = ½·q·C·B·H²。取 q = 2.5 kPa、C = 1.3、B = 50 m、H = 500 m，M = 0.5×2,500×1.3×50×500² ≈ 20.3 GN·m；若角隅修形使等效係數降低 25%，M 約降為 15.2 GN·m，基礎與巨柱軸力隨之同比例減少。數值為教學假設。~Estimate the base moment from a uniform equivalent pressure, M = ½·q·C·B·H². With q = 2.5 kPa, C = 1.3, B = 50 m and H = 500 m, M = 0.5×2,500×1.3×50×500² ≈ 20.3 GN·m; if corner shaping lowers the equivalent coefficient by 25%, M falls to about 15.2 GN·m and foundation and mega-column forces drop in proportion. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 要求風洞報告分別列出三種回歸期的基底彎矩、變位與頂層加速度，並附角隅修形與未修形的比較試驗；高頻力平衡結果要以結構實際模態重新組合，再與規範公式估算比對，差異超過約兩成時必須查明原因並書面說明。~Require the wind-tunnel report to list base moments, drifts and top-floor accelerations separately for the three return periods, with comparative tests of notched and unnotched corners; recombine force-balance results with the structure's actual modes, compare with code-formula estimates, and investigate and document any difference larger than about 20%.
units.failure: 若只拿 100 年強度風載設計構架而未檢核半年回歸期加速度，結構雖安全，常見颱風時高樓層使用者仍會明顯不適；若角隅缺角在施工中為了帷幕牆單元化而被簡化，實際風力可能回到未修形的較高水準。~Designing the frame only for 100-year strength loads without checking half-year accelerations leaves a safe structure that still makes upper-floor occupants uncomfortable in common typhoons; if the corner notches are simplified during construction to ease unitised cladding, actual wind forces can revert to the higher unnotched level.
units.misconception: 角隅缺角主要是造型裝飾，對結構風力沒有實質影響。~Corner notches are mainly decorative and have no real effect on structural wind loads.
units.practice: 把三級風力準則與允收值寫入結構設計基準書，任何外形變更（角隅尺寸、塔頂與帷幕牆突出物）都必須回送風工程顧問評估，並在變更紀錄中保留風洞比對資料。~Write the three-tier wind criteria and acceptance values into the structural design basis, send any change of external form (corner dimensions, crown, façade projections) back to the wind consultant for assessment, and keep the wind-tunnel comparison in the change record.

units.title: 外伸桁架把傾覆彎矩轉成巨柱軸力~Outriggers turn overturning into mega-column axial force
units.mechanism: 台北 101 周邊有八支巨柱（每面兩支），26 樓以下每面另有次巨柱與角柱經帶狀桁架加入；外伸桁架約每 8 至 10 層一道，依位置做成單層、雙層或三層高。核心筒受風彎曲時，外伸桁架像槓桿一樣把核心的轉角變成巨柱軸力：一側減壓、另一側增壓，形成力偶抵抗大部分傾覆彎矩。因為巨柱本身已承受很大的重力壓力，風或地震造成的軸力變化多半只是減少壓力，但柱續接仍須檢核少量的淨上拉。~Taipei 101 has eight perimeter mega-columns, two per face; below level 26, sub-super columns and corner columns on each face are engaged through belt trusses. Outriggers occur about every 8 to 10 floors and are one, two or three storeys deep depending on location. When the core bends in wind, the outriggers act as levers that turn core rotation into mega-column axial force, unloading one side and adding compression to the other, so a couple resists most of the overturning moment. Because the mega-columns already carry heavy gravity compression, wind or seismic axial changes mostly reduce compression, yet column splices must still be checked for small net uplift.
units.model: 巨柱力偶 ΔN = M_col/(a·n)。若外伸桁架交給巨柱的彎矩 M_col = 12 GN·m，受拉側與受壓側巨柱群形心距 a = 40 m、每側 n = 4 支，ΔN = 12×10⁹/(40×4) = 75 MN；重力軸力若為 350 MN，風作用時兩側分別為 275 MN 與 425 MN。數值為教學假設。~Mega-column couple ΔN = M_col/(a·n). If the outriggers deliver M_col = 12 GN·m to the columns, with a = 40 m between tension-side and compression-side group centroids and n = 4 columns per side, ΔN = 12×10⁹/(40×4) = 75 MN; with 350 MN of gravity load, the two sides carry 275 MN and 425 MN under wind. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在三維模型中分別輸出核心與巨柱各自承擔的傾覆彎矩比例，並與只有核心時的頂層變位比較；再以手算力偶核對各道外伸桁架的弦桿與斜桿力，確認每一道外伸桁架的分擔比例與其勁度排序一致。~Output from the three-dimensional model the share of overturning carried by the core and by the mega-columns, and compare top drift with a core-only model; then check the chord and diagonal forces in each outrigger level with a hand couple calculation, confirming that each level's share matches its stiffness ranking.
units.failure: 若外伸桁架與巨柱接合的勁度被高估，模型中的力偶會比實際大，核心筒承受的彎矩被低估；反之若接合過早鎖固而未考慮差異縮短，巨柱與外伸桁架會在完工後承受額外的重力附加力。~Overestimating the stiffness of outrigger-to-column joints makes the modelled couple larger than reality and understates core bending; conversely, locking the joints too early without allowing for differential shortening imposes additional gravity-induced forces on columns and outriggers after completion.
units.misconception: 外伸桁架設得越多越好，每層都設最能減少變位。~The more outriggers the better; one on every floor reduces drift most.
units.practice: 在設計書中列出每一道外伸桁架的樓層、深度、所連接的巨柱與分擔比例，柱續接處標明最大淨上拉的載重組合，並要求鋼構製造圖保留這些標記以便現場查核。~List in the design report each outrigger's level, depth, connected mega-columns and share of overturning, mark the governing net-uplift load combination at column splices, and require shop drawings to carry these marks for site checking.

units.anchor: 鋼箱填充混凝土巨柱~Concrete-filled steel box mega-column
units.title: 巨柱合成斷面與軸壓容量~Composite mega-column section and axial capacity
units.mechanism: 台北 101 的巨柱底部約 2.4 m × 3.0 m，由厚 50 至 80 mm 的鋼板焊成箱形，內灌設計強度約 10,000 psi（約 69 MPa）的高強度混凝土，並以內部繫材防止鋼板外鼓。鋼箱提供模板、圍束與抗拉能力，混凝土提供大部分軸壓勁度並阻止鋼板向內挫屈，兩者合作的效率高於各自單獨使用。斷面隨高度逐段縮小，填充高度也分段結束（核心箱形柱與巨柱填至約 62 層），每一段的合成比例不同，計算必須逐段進行。~Taipei 101's mega-columns are about 2.4 m × 3.0 m at the base, welded into boxes from 50 to 80 mm plates and filled with high-strength concrete of about 10,000 psi (about 69 MPa) design strength, with internal ties preventing the plates from bulging. The steel box provides formwork, confinement and tension capacity, while the concrete supplies most of the axial stiffness and stops the plates buckling inwards, so together they outperform either material alone. The section shrinks with height and the fill stops at different levels (core box columns and super columns are filled to about level 62), so the composite proportions change and must be checked segment by segment.
units.model: 名目擠壓強度 N₀ = A_s·f_y + 0.85·f_c·A_c。2.4 m × 3.0 m、板厚 80 mm：A_c = 2.24×2.84 = 6.36 m²、A_s = 7.20 − 6.36 = 0.84 m²；f_y = 414 MPa、f_c = 69 MPa，N₀ = 0.84×414 + 0.85×69×6.36 ≈ 347 + 373 = 720 MN。若混凝土只有 41 MPa，N₀ 約 569 MN，下降約 21%。數值為教學假設，未計長細比與強度折減。~Nominal squash load N₀ = A_s·f_y + 0.85·f_c·A_c. For 2.4 m × 3.0 m with 80 mm plate: A_c = 2.24×2.84 = 6.36 m² and A_s = 7.20 − 6.36 = 0.84 m²; with f_y = 414 MPa and f_c = 69 MPa, N₀ = 0.84×414 + 0.85×69×6.36 ≈ 347 + 373 = 720 MN. With only 41 MPa concrete N₀ is about 569 MN, roughly 21% less. Teaching assumptions, ignoring slenderness and resistance factors.
units.verify: 逐段建立巨柱斷面表（外尺寸、板厚、填充起訖樓層、混凝土強度），以合成柱公式與有限元素斷面分析互相核對；確認重力加風或地震組合下的軸力比在允許範圍，並檢查柱續接與隔板位置與製造圖一致。~Build a segment-by-segment mega-column schedule (outer size, plate thickness, fill start and end levels, concrete strength), cross-check composite-column formulas with finite-element section analysis, confirm the axial-load ratio under gravity plus wind or earthquake is within limits, and check that splice and diaphragm locations match the shop drawings.
units.failure: 若圖面上的填充高度與實際澆置高度不符，未填充段只能靠鋼板單獨受力，容量可能比計算值少兩成以上；混凝土收縮在隔板下方留下空隙時，該處的圍束與傳力也會局部失效。~If the drawn fill level differs from the actual pour, unfilled segments rely on the steel plates alone and can fall more than 20% below the calculated capacity; shrinkage voids under diaphragm plates also locally defeat confinement and load transfer.
units.misconception: 鋼箱巨柱裡的混凝土只是為了增加重量與防火。~The concrete inside a steel-box mega-column is only there to add weight and fire protection.
units.practice: 巨柱斷面表要同時出現在結構圖、鋼構製造圖與混凝土澆置計畫，每一段標明填充起訖樓層與強度；每次澆置前由監造確認隔板排氣孔與灌注孔位置，列為停止點。~Show the mega-column schedule on the structural drawings, steel shop drawings and concrete placement plan, marking fill start and end levels and strength for each segment; before every pour the resident engineer confirms diaphragm vent and filling holes as a hold point.

units.anchor: SM570M 厚鋼板與柱續接~SM570M thick plates and column splices
units.title: 高強度厚板鋼材與全滲透焊接~High-strength thick plate and full-penetration welding
units.mechanism: 台北 101 的主要鋼構使用 SM570M 等級鋼材，降伏強度約 60 ksi 以上，板厚可達 80 mm。厚板焊接時冷卻快、拘束大，容易產生氫致裂紋與層狀撕裂，因此規格同時限制碳當量（板厚 40 mm 以下約 0.44%、40 mm 以上約 0.47%）與降伏比（較厚的梁與斜撐約 80%、較薄者約 85%），確保焊接性與塑性變形能力。柱續接採全滲透焊，以抵抗風與地震下可能出現的少量淨上拉。~Taipei 101's main steelwork uses SM570M steel with a yield strength of about 60 ksi or more and plates up to 80 mm thick. Thick plates cool quickly and are highly restrained during welding, inviting hydrogen cracking and lamellar tearing, so the specification limited both the carbon equivalent (about 0.44% for plates under 40 mm and about 0.47% for 40 mm and thicker) and the yield ratio (about 80% for thicker girders and braces, about 85% for thinner ones) to secure weldability and plastic deformation capacity. Column splices are full-penetration welds to resist the small net uplift that wind and earthquakes can produce.
units.model: 碳當量 Ceq = C + Mn/6 + (Cr+Mo+V)/5 + (Ni+Cu)/15。取 C 0.16、Mn 1.45、Cr 0.02、Mo 0、V 0.04、Ni 0.02、Cu 0.02，Ceq = 0.16 + 0.242 + 0.012 + 0.003 ≈ 0.42%，低於 0.47% 上限；降伏比 440/600 ≈ 0.73，低於 0.80。數值為教學假設，不是實際鋼廠成分。~Carbon equivalent Ceq = C + Mn/6 + (Cr+Mo+V)/5 + (Ni+Cu)/15. With C 0.16, Mn 1.45, Cr 0.02, Mo 0, V 0.04, Ni 0.02 and Cu 0.02, Ceq = 0.16 + 0.242 + 0.012 + 0.003 ≈ 0.42%, below the 0.47% limit; the yield ratio 440/600 ≈ 0.73 is below 0.80. Teaching assumptions, not actual mill chemistry.
units.verify: 每一爐號的鋼材證明書都要核對化學成分、降伏比與板厚方向性能（Z 向斷面收縮率），焊接程序以實際板厚做資格檢定；施焊時記錄預熱與層間溫度，完成後以超音波檢測全滲透焊並依規範判定合格與否。~Check every heat's mill certificate for chemistry, yield ratio and through-thickness (Z-direction reduction of area) properties, qualify welding procedures on the actual plate thickness, record preheat and interpass temperatures during welding, and ultrasonically test every full-penetration weld against the code acceptance criteria.
units.failure: 厚板未充分預熱或焊材含氫量過高時，焊後數小時至數天才出現的延遲裂紋可能在檢測前就被覆蓋；層狀撕裂常出現在 T 形接頭的母材內部，在地震反覆載重下會成為斷裂起點。~Without adequate preheat or with high-hydrogen consumables, delayed cracks that appear hours or days after welding may be covered before inspection; lamellar tears form inside the base metal of T-joints and become fracture initiation points under cyclic seismic loading.
units.misconception: 鋼材強度等級越高越好，降伏比高一點也沒有關係。~The higher the steel grade the better, and a high yield ratio does not matter.
units.practice: 對厚板全滲透焊設定「冷卻 48 小時後才做超音波檢測」的停止點，保留每道焊道的焊工代號、預熱紀錄與檢測報告；任何補焊都要重新檢測，並經設計單位同意後才可覆蓋。~Set a hold point of ultrasonic testing no earlier than 48 hours after cooling for thick full-penetration welds, keep the welder ID, preheat record and test report for each weld, and re-test every repair weld, covering it only after the designer approves.

units.anchor: 反循環基樁與岩盤嵌入~Reverse-circulation piles and rock sockets
units.title: 台北盆地軟黏土上的基樁與筏基~Piles and raft in the soft Taipei basin
units.mechanism: 台北 101 基地上方約 30 m 為湖積粉土質黏土（上部約 20 m 很軟），其下為崩積層，岩盤（桂竹林層）約在地表下 40 至 65 m，頂部約 10 m 膠結不良。塔樓下設 380 支直徑 1.5 m、中心距約 3.96 m 的反循環鑽掘基樁，嵌入岩盤 15 至 33 m，上方為厚 3.0 至 4.7 m 的筏基，配合約 22 m 深的五層地下室開挖。基樁主要靠岩盤段的側摩擦承載，筏基則把巨柱與核心的集中力分配到整個樁群。~At the Taipei 101 site the top 30 m or so is lacustrine silty clay, the upper 20 m very soft, over colluvium, with bedrock of the Kueichulin Formation at about 40 to 65 m below ground and a poorly cemented top 10 m. Under the tower, 380 reverse-circulation bored piles of 1.5 m diameter at about 3.96 m centres are socketed 15 to 33 m into rock, capped by a raft 3.0 to 4.7 m thick within an excavation about 22 m deep for the five-level basement. The piles carry load mainly by side friction in the rock socket, while the raft spreads the concentrated mega-column and core loads across the whole group.
units.model: 岩盤段側摩擦 Q = π·D·L·f_s。取 D = 1.5 m、嵌入長 L = 20 m、單位側摩擦 f_s = 0.30 MPa，Q = π×1.5×20×0.30 ≈ 28.3 MN，安全係數 2 時容許約 14.1 MN。樁距 3.96/1.5 ≈ 2.6 倍樁徑，群樁效應會增加沉陷。數值為教學假設。~Rock-socket side resistance Q = π·D·L·f_s. With D = 1.5 m, socket length L = 20 m and unit side friction f_s = 0.30 MPa, Q = π×1.5×20×0.30 ≈ 28.3 MN, about 14.1 MN allowable with a factor of safety of 2. The spacing of 3.96/1.5 ≈ 2.6 diameters means group effects increase settlement. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以試驗樁做靜載試驗：公開論文記載壓力試驗最大約 40.6 MN、拉拔試驗最大約 22 MN，並在塔樓區做生產樁驗證試驗；以應變計分段量測側摩擦、回推 t–z 曲線，再與群樁沉陷分析比較（計算長期最大沉陷約 65 mm，施工期間量得塔中心沉陷小於約 20 mm）。~Load-test trial piles statically; the published paper records compression tests up to about 40.6 MN and pull-out tests up to about 22 MN, plus proof tests on production piles in the tower area. Measure side friction segment by segment with strain gauges, back-calculate t–z curves and compare with group-settlement analysis, which predicted about 65 mm long-term maximum while under about 20 mm was measured at the tower centre during construction.
units.failure: 反循環鑽掘時若孔壁在軟黏土段坍落或孔底沉泥未清除，岩盤段的側摩擦與端承都會大幅下降；樁群中少數樁偏軟會讓筏基不均勻沉陷，使高聳結構傾斜，並在巨柱與核心之間產生附加內力。~If the borehole wall collapses in the soft clay or bottom slime is not cleaned during reverse-circulation drilling, socket friction and end bearing drop sharply; a few soft piles in the group cause uneven raft settlement, tilting the tall structure and inducing extra forces between mega-columns and core.
units.misconception: 只要基樁打到岩盤，沉陷就可以忽略。~Once piles reach bedrock, settlement can be ignored.
units.practice: 每支樁記錄鑽掘深度、入岩長度、孔底清理與穩定液性質，澆置前以測深與超音波檢查孔形；開挖期間同步監測鄰房與地下水位，任何異常即暫停開挖，由大地工程顧問判斷後才可續作。~Record drilled depth, socket length, base cleaning and drilling-fluid properties for each pile, sound and ultrasonically profile the hole before concreting, and monitor neighbouring buildings and groundwater during excavation, stopping work on any anomaly until the geotechnical consultant decides.

units.anchor: 爬升式塔吊支承點~Climbing tower-crane supports
units.title: 331 地震塔吊墜落與臨時結構耐震~The 2002 crane collapse and seismic design of temporary works
units.mechanism: 2002 年 3 月 31 日花蓮外海規模 6.8 地震時，施工中的台北 101 有兩部位於 56 樓的塔吊被震落，造成五人死亡。當時鋼構約施工到 53 至 56 樓、樓板混凝土約到 34 樓、柱內填充約到 32 樓，塔吊支承在 47 與 51 樓；未完成的結構缺少樓板隔膜與填充混凝土，比完工狀態更柔、更不均勻，高處又會放大地表加速度。塔吊及其支承與繫結屬於臨時工程，卻同樣需要以地震力檢核。~In the magnitude 6.8 earthquake off Hualien on 31 March 2002, two tower cranes at level 56 of the unfinished Taipei 101 were shaken loose, killing five people. Steel was then erected to about levels 53 to 56, slab concrete to about level 34 and column infill to about level 32, with crane supports at levels 47 and 51; the incomplete frame lacked floor diaphragms and infill, so it was more flexible and less regular than the finished building, and height amplified the ground acceleration. Cranes, their supports and ties are temporary works, yet they must be checked for seismic forces just like the permanent structure.
units.model: 附近測站東西向尖峰約 193 gal，即 0.197 g；若施工中高樓層放大 2.5 倍，塔吊處約 0.49 g。塔吊質量 120 t 時水平慣性力 F = m·a = 120,000×0.49×9.81 ≈ 579 kN，作用於支承上方 20 m 時彎矩約 11,580 kN·m，支承間距 4 m 時繫結力約 2,895 kN。數值為教學假設。~A nearby station recorded about 193 gal east–west, or 0.197 g; with 2.5 times amplification at the upper construction levels the crane sees about 0.49 g. For a 120 t crane the horizontal inertia force is F = m·a = 120,000×0.49×9.81 ≈ 579 kN; acting 20 m above the supports it gives about 11,580 kN·m, or a tie force of about 2,895 kN for supports 4 m apart. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 塔吊基座、爬升框與繫結要以施工階段結構模型分析，輸入當地設計地震與颱風風速，並檢查支承樓層在該階段的實際強度（混凝土是否已澆置、構件是否已鎖固）；地震後由專業技師檢查繫結螺栓、焊道與爬升楔塊，確認無損後才可恢復吊裝。~Analyse crane bases, climbing frames and ties with a construction-stage model using the local design earthquake and typhoon wind, checking the supporting floors at their actual stage of completion (concrete placed or not, members fully connected or not); after any earthquake, have a professional engineer inspect tie bolts, welds and climbing wedges and confirm no damage before lifting resumes.
units.failure: 公開資料指出，事故後檢方調查是否有疏失，工程停工約三個月並依委員會建議復工。一般而言，塔吊繫結與爬升支承若只按吊重與風力設計，強震時可能在支承點或塔身斷面先破壞，墜落物又會撞擊下方樓板與人員。~Public records state that prosecutors investigated possible negligence and that work stopped for about three months before resuming on a committee's recommendation. In general, crane ties and climbing supports designed only for lifted load and wind can fail first at supports or tower sections in a strong earthquake, and falling parts then strike the floors and people below.
units.misconception: 塔吊是臨時設備，不需要考慮地震力。~Tower cranes are temporary equipment and need not be designed for earthquakes.
units.practice: 塔吊的地震與颱風作業限制、強制停機與吊臂放鬆迴轉程序要寫入施工計畫；每次爬升前後各設停止點，由結構設計者確認支承樓層的施工階段強度並簽認，未簽認不得爬升。~Write the earthquake and typhoon operating limits, mandatory shutdown and free-slew procedures for cranes into the construction plan; set hold points before and after each climb at which the structural designer confirms and signs off the stage strength of the supporting floors, with no climbing until signed.

units.anchor: 隔板下方空隙檢測~Voids under diaphragm plates
units.title: 巨柱填充混凝土的配比與充填驗收~Infill concrete mix and fill acceptance
units.mechanism: 箱形巨柱內有水平隔板與繫材，混凝土必須流過狹窄孔口填滿每個角落，又無法振動搗實，因此採用高流動、自充填的配比。台北 101 的規格要求 90 天設計強度 10,000 psi、坍度約 250 ± 20 mm、坍流度約 600 ± 20 mm，隔板下方空隙不超過面積的 5%，並限制 90 天自體收縮約 300 × 10⁻⁶。隔板下的空隙最難避免，因為氣泡與泌水會集中在板底。~A box mega-column contains horizontal diaphragms and ties, so concrete must flow through narrow openings to fill every corner without vibration, which calls for a highly fluid self-consolidating mix. Taipei 101's specification called for 10,000 psi design strength at 90 days, slump about 250 ± 20 mm, slump flow about 600 ± 20 mm, voids under diaphragm plates of no more than 5% of the area, and autogenous shrinkage limited to about 300 × 10⁻⁶ at 90 days. Voids under diaphragms are the hardest to avoid because air bubbles and bleed water collect beneath the plate.
units.model: 隔板下淨面積 A_d = 2.24×2.84 ≈ 6.36 m²，若檢測到空隙 0.25 m²，比例 = 0.25/6.36 ≈ 3.9%，低於 5% 上限；自體收縮 300 × 10⁻⁶ 在 4.2 m 樓高內造成約 300×10⁻⁶×4,200 ≈ 1.3 mm 的縮短，足以在板底拉開一道縫。數值為教學假設。~The net area under a diaphragm is A_d = 2.24×2.84 ≈ 6.36 m²; a detected void of 0.25 m² gives 0.25/6.36 ≈ 3.9%, below the 5% limit. Autogenous shrinkage of 300 × 10⁻⁶ over a 4.2 m storey shortens the fill by about 300×10⁻⁶×4,200 ≈ 1.3 mm, enough to open a gap under a plate. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 先以足尺模型柱試灌，硬化後切開量測隔板下空隙並調整配比與排氣孔；正式施工時以敲擊或超音波檢查隔板附近是否空洞，記錄每一車的坍流度與溫度並取圓柱試體，空隙超標處鑽孔注漿補強並重新檢測。~First cast a full-scale mock-up column and cut it open after hardening to measure voids under diaphragms, adjusting the mix and vent holes; during production check around diaphragms by tapping or ultrasonic testing, record slump flow and temperature of every truck with cylinders taken, and drill, grout and re-test wherever voids exceed the limit.
units.failure: 坍流度不足或澆置速度過快會把空氣封在隔板下，形成大面積空洞；過度泌水則在板底留下弱化水膜，地震時巨柱局部的圍束與剪力傳遞降低，鋼板可能向內挫屈。~Inadequate slump flow or too fast a placement traps air under diaphragms in large voids; excessive bleeding leaves a weak water film under the plate, so in an earthquake local confinement and shear transfer in the mega-column drop and the plate may buckle inwards.
units.misconception: 自充填混凝土會自動填滿鋼箱，不需要開孔排氣或檢測。~Self-consolidating concrete fills a steel box automatically, so no vent holes or testing are needed.
units.practice: 每一段巨柱澆置前確認排氣孔暢通與澆置管位置，並設「模型柱試驗合格」與「前一段空隙檢測完成」兩個停止點；檢測結果標註在巨柱斷面表上，成為竣工紀錄的一部分。~Before each mega-column pour confirm clear vent holes and placement-pipe positions, with two hold points per segment, mock-up approval and completion of void checks on the previous segment; mark the results on the mega-column schedule as part of the as-built record.

units.anchor: 減弱斷面梁與塑性轉角~Reduced beam sections and plastic rotation
units.title: 兩級地震性能與非線性驗證~Two-level seismic performance and nonlinear checks
units.mechanism: 台北 101 的耐震設計以兩級地震檢核：約 100 年回歸期地震下結構保持彈性，約 950 年回歸期地震下維持穩定不倒塌，並以非線性時間歷程分析驗證。周邊抗彎構架須能獨立承擔規範要求的 25% 地震力，形成雙重系統；分析中梁端塑性轉角超過約 0.005 弧度的位置改用減弱斷面梁（狗骨頭切削），把塑性鉸從柱面移開，以保護焊接接頭。~Taipei 101's seismic design checks two levels: the structure stays elastic in an earthquake of roughly 100-year return period and remains stable without collapse in one of roughly 950 years, verified by nonlinear time-history analysis. The perimeter moment frames must independently carry the code-required 25% of the seismic force, forming a dual system; where analysis shows beam-end plastic rotations above about 0.005 rad, reduced beam sections (dogbone cuts) move the plastic hinge away from the column face to protect the welded joint.
units.model: 塑性轉角 θ_p ≈ θ_total − θ_y。若層間變位角 1/90 = 0.0111 rad、梁降伏轉角 0.0060 rad，θ_p ≈ 0.0051 rad，超過 0.005 rad 門檻，需改用減弱斷面；雙重系統下若總基底剪力 V = 100 MN，抗彎構架單獨須能承擔 0.25×100 = 25 MN。數值為教學假設。~Plastic rotation θ_p ≈ θ_total − θ_y. With a storey drift angle of 1/90 = 0.0111 rad and a beam yield rotation of 0.0060 rad, θ_p ≈ 0.0051 rad, above the 0.005 rad threshold, so a reduced beam section is needed; in the dual system, if total base shear V = 100 MN, the moment frame alone must carry 0.25×100 = 25 MN. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以多組符合場址條件的地震紀錄做非線性時間歷程分析，逐層輸出層間變位角與梁端塑性轉角分布，並與兩級性能目標比對；再把核心斜撐移除、只留抗彎構架做一次分析，確認 25% 的獨立承載要求。減弱斷面的切削尺寸以實尺寸試驗或文獻試驗資料佐證。~Run nonlinear time-history analyses with several site-appropriate records, output storey drift angles and beam-end plastic rotations floor by floor and compare them with the two performance targets; then analyse the moment frame alone with the core bracing removed to confirm the independent 25% requirement, and support reduced-section cut dimensions with full-scale or published test data.
units.failure: 1994 年美國北嶺地震中，許多鋼構抗彎接頭在梁翼焊道附近脆性斷裂，促成減弱斷面梁等改良接頭；若切削位置錯誤或圓弧加工粗糙，塑性鉸仍可能回到柱面，或在切削處提早斷裂。~In the 1994 Northridge earthquake many steel moment connections fractured in a brittle manner near the beam-flange welds, prompting improved details such as the reduced beam section; if the cut is mislocated or its radius poorly finished, the hinge can migrate back to the column face or fracture prematurely at the cut.
units.misconception: 雙重系統中的抗彎構架只是分擔核心剩下的力，從不需要單獨承擔。~In a dual system the moment frame only shares what the core leaves over and never needs to stand alone.
units.practice: 減弱斷面梁的切削尺寸、位置與表面粗糙度列為檢驗項目，以樣板量測並拍照紀錄；任何因管線而修改梁翼的現場要求，都必須回到設計單位重新檢核塑性鉸位置後才可施作。~Make reduced-section cut dimensions, location and surface roughness inspection items, measured with templates and photographed; any field request to modify beam flanges for services must go back to the designer to re-check the plastic hinge location before work proceeds.

units.anchor: 阻尼器事件擺幅紀錄~Damper event-swing records
units.title: 颱風與地震後的阻尼器紀錄與檢查~Damper records and inspection after typhoons and earthquakes
units.mechanism: 台北 101 的主擺錘在營運期間累積了一系列事件紀錄：2015 年 8 月蘇迪勒颱風時擺幅約 100 cm，為歷來最大；2019 年 4 月規模 6.1 地震時約 20 cm，是當時地震造成的最大擺幅。這些紀錄是結構健康的證據：擺幅、方向與持續時間可與同時段的風速及地震紀錄比對，判斷阻尼器是否仍在調頻範圍、緩衝系統是否被碰觸，並決定事件後的檢查深度。本單元把阻尼器當作監測儀器使用，不重複其調頻原理。~Taipei 101's main pendulum has built up a record of events in service: about 100 cm of swing in Typhoon Soudelor in August 2015, the largest so far, and about 20 cm in a magnitude 6.1 earthquake in April 2019, then the largest earthquake-induced swing. These records are structural-health evidence: amplitude, direction and duration can be compared with concurrent wind and earthquake records to judge whether the damper is still in tune and whether the bumper system was touched, and to set the depth of post-event inspection. This unit uses the damper as a monitoring instrument rather than revisiting its tuning theory.
units.model: 擺錘簡諧運動的最大速度 v = 2π·f·A。取 f = 0.14 Hz、A = 1.0 m，v = 2π×0.14×1.0 ≈ 0.88 m/s，660 t 擺錘的動能 ½·m·v² ≈ 0.5×660,000×0.88² ≈ 256 kJ；若設計行程為 ±1.5 m，行程使用率約 1.0/1.5 ≈ 67%。數值為教學假設。~For harmonic pendulum motion the peak velocity is v = 2π·f·A. With f = 0.14 Hz and A = 1.0 m, v = 2π×0.14×1.0 ≈ 0.88 m/s and a 660 t pendulum carries ½·m·v² ≈ 0.5×660,000×0.88² ≈ 256 kJ; against a design stroke of ±1.5 m the stroke utilisation is about 1.0/1.5 ≈ 67%. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 事件後先調出擺錘位移、樓層加速度與風速或地震紀錄，確認最大擺幅與行程限制之間的餘裕；接著目視檢查緩衝環接觸痕跡、阻尼器漏油、吊索與吊點，必要時以自由擺動量測頻率是否仍與基準值相符，結果寫入事件報告。~After an event, retrieve pendulum displacement, floor acceleration and wind or earthquake records and confirm the margin between peak swing and stroke limits; then inspect bumper-ring contact marks, damper leaks, hangers and pick points, and if needed measure the free-swing frequency against the baseline, recording the results in an event report.
units.failure: 若事件紀錄沒有時間同步，擺錘位移無法對應風速，就分不出大擺幅來自強風還是阻尼器失調；事件後若省略緩衝器檢查，隱藏的損傷可能要到下一次颱風才顯現。~Without time-synchronised records, pendulum displacement cannot be matched to wind speed, so a large swing cannot be attributed to strong wind or to detuning; skipping the post-event bumper inspection lets hidden damage surface only in the next typhoon.
units.misconception: 阻尼器擺幅創紀錄，就代表大樓結構出了問題。~A record damper swing means something is wrong with the building structure.
units.practice: 建立事件分級：擺幅或樓層加速度超過設定門檻即啟動詳細檢查；每次事件的擺幅、風速、處置與檢查結果累積成趨勢表，提供結構顧問年度審查並作為調頻複核的依據。~Set event tiers in which swing or floor acceleration above set thresholds triggers a detailed inspection, and accumulate each event's swing, wind speed, actions and findings into a trend table for the structural consultant's annual review and as the basis for re-checking the tuning.

units.anchor: 帷幕牆玻璃與層間變位~Curtain-wall glass and storey drift
units.title: 颱風風壓下的帷幕玻璃與長期維護~Curtain-wall glass under typhoon pressure and long-term upkeep
units.mechanism: 台北 101 位於颱風區，帷幕單元面積大，玻璃供應商指出必須使用比一般更厚的玻璃基板，單片面積平均約 40 平方英尺（約 3.7 m²），窗間牆部位則使用客製的陶瓷釉面玻璃。帷幕牆同時承受正負風壓與樓層間的相對變位：風壓使玻璃彎曲，層間變位則讓框架變成平行四邊形，必須靠框內間隙與可滑動的連接件吸收。長期維護的重點是密封膠、墊片、破損玻璃更換，以及外牆維護設備的可達性。~Taipei 101 stands in a typhoon zone with large curtain-wall units; its glass supplier states that thicker-than-typical glass substrates were needed, with individual units averaging about 40 ft² (about 3.7 m²) and custom ceramic-frit glass in the spandrels. The curtain wall must resist positive and negative wind pressure and relative storey movement at the same time: pressure bends the glass, while drift racks the frame into a parallelogram that edge clearances and sliding connections must absorb. Long-term upkeep centres on sealants, gaskets, broken-glass replacement and access for façade maintenance equipment.
units.model: 四邊簡支玻璃板最大應力 σ = β·p·a²/t²。短邊 a = 1.5 m、厚 t = 12 mm、風壓 p = 4.0 kPa、β = 0.48，σ = 0.48×4,000×1.5²/0.012² = 30 MPa；層間變位角 1/200、樓高 4.2 m 時，框架水平錯動 4,200/200 = 21 mm，需由框內間隙與滑動連接吸收。數值為教學假設。~Peak stress in a four-side-supported glass plate is σ = β·p·a²/t². With short side a = 1.5 m, thickness t = 12 mm, pressure p = 4.0 kPa and β = 0.48, σ = 0.48×4,000×1.5²/0.012² = 30 MPa; a drift angle of 1/200 over a 4.2 m storey racks the frame 4,200/200 = 21 mm, which edge clearances and sliding connections must absorb. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以實尺寸帷幕牆試體做風壓（含颱風循環）、水密、氣密與層間變位試驗，確認玻璃不破、密封不漏水；完工後定期以目視與望遠鏡檢查密封膠劣化與玻璃自爆，並記錄每片更換玻璃的位置、原因與規格。~Test full-scale curtain-wall mock-ups for wind pressure including typhoon cycles, water and air tightness and storey-drift racking, confirming no glass breakage or leakage; after completion inspect visually and with binoculars for sealant ageing and spontaneous glass breakage, recording the location, cause and specification of every replaced pane.
units.failure: 若帷幕牆連接件在安裝時被誤鎖死，層間變位會直接擠壓玻璃，造成角部破裂；颱風期間一片玻璃破損會讓室內受壓，進而吹落隔間與天花板，碎片也成為高空墜落物。~If curtain-wall connections are mistakenly locked during installation, storey drift squeezes the glass directly and cracks the corners; one broken pane in a typhoon pressurises the interior, blowing out partitions and ceilings and turning fragments into falling debris.
units.misconception: 帷幕牆只是外觀，不需要配合結構的變位來設計。~A curtain wall is cosmetic and need not be designed for structural movement.
units.practice: 交接文件要附帷幕牆試驗報告、各樓層允許層間變位、連接件滑動方向圖與備品玻璃清單；颱風季前檢查外牆維護設備的固定與停放，颱風後逐層巡檢，並把破損紀錄回饋給結構與帷幕顧問。~Handover should include curtain-wall test reports, allowable storey drift per floor, sliding-direction diagrams for connections and a spare-glass list; before typhoon season check the securing and parking of façade maintenance equipment, and after typhoons inspect floor by floor, feeding breakage records back to the structural and façade consultants.

example: 巨柱檢核練習：某鋼箱填充混凝土巨柱 2.4 m × 3.0 m、板厚 80 mm，f_y = 414 MPa、f_c = 69 MPa。A_c = 2.24×2.84 = 6.36 m²、A_s = 0.84 m²，名目擠壓強度 N₀ = 0.84×414 + 0.85×69×6.36 ≈ 720 MN，取強度折減 0.75 得設計容量約 540 MN。外伸桁架傳來的彎矩 12 GN·m 由力臂 40 m、每側 4 支巨柱分擔，ΔN = 12,000/(40×4) = 75 MN；重力軸力 350 MN 時受壓側合計 425 MN，使用率 425/540 ≈ 0.79。若填充混凝土只達 41 MPa，N₀ 約 569 MN、設計容量約 427 MN，使用率升到約 1.00，已無餘裕；若外伸桁架勁度不足使 M_col 降為 8 GN·m，ΔN 減為 50 MN，但核心筒須多承擔 4 GN·m。數值為教學假設，不代表台北 101 的設計值。~Mega-column check: a concrete-filled steel box 2.4 m × 3.0 m with 80 mm plate, f_y = 414 MPa and f_c = 69 MPa. A_c = 2.24×2.84 = 6.36 m² and A_s = 0.84 m², so the nominal squash load is N₀ = 0.84×414 + 0.85×69×6.36 ≈ 720 MN, or about 540 MN design capacity with a resistance factor of 0.75. An outrigger moment of 12 GN·m shared over a 40 m lever arm by 4 columns per side gives ΔN = 12,000/(40×4) = 75 MN; with 350 MN of gravity load the compression side carries 425 MN, a utilisation of 425/540 ≈ 0.79. If the infill reaches only 41 MPa, N₀ is about 569 MN and design capacity about 427 MN, pushing utilisation to about 1.00 with no margin left; if softer outriggers reduce M_col to 8 GN·m, ΔN drops to 50 MN but the core must carry an extra 4 GN·m. Values are teaching assumptions, not Taipei 101's design values.
history: 台北 101 由李祖原建築師事務所設計，永峻工程顧問擔任結構設計，Thornton Tomasetti 提供結構概念與初步設計並審查最終設計；1999 年開工、2004 年完工，以 508 m 成為 2004 至 2010 年的世界最高建築。它在颱風與強震並存的台北盆地軟弱地層上，以八支鋼箱填充混凝土巨柱、斜撐核心與多道外伸桁架組成抗側系統，並以岩盤嵌入基樁支承；2002 年地震造成施工中塔吊墜落，凸顯施工階段臨時結構的耐震責任。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Taipei 101 was designed by C.Y. Lee & Partners, with Evergreen Consulting Engineering as structural engineer and Thornton Tomasetti providing the structural concept and preliminary design and reviewing the final design; construction began in 1999 and finished in 2004, and at 508 m it was the world's tallest building from 2004 to 2010. Facing both typhoons and strong earthquakes on the soft Taipei basin, it combines eight concrete-filled steel-box mega-columns, a braced core and multiple outriggers into its lateral system on rock-socketed piles; the 2002 earthquake that toppled two cranes during construction highlighted the seismic responsibility of temporary works. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: 台北 101 建築高度 508 m，地上 101 層、地下 5 層，2004 年完工~Taipei 101 is 508 m tall with 101 storeys above ground and 5 below, completed in 2004
周邊共 8 支巨柱，底部約 2.4 m × 3.0 m，以 50 至 80 mm 鋼板焊成~Eight perimeter mega-columns measure about 2.4 m × 3.0 m at the base, built from 50 to 80 mm plates
巨柱與核心箱形柱填充約 10,000 psi（約 69 MPa）混凝土，核心柱填至約 62 層~Mega-columns and core box columns are filled with about 10,000 psi (about 69 MPa) concrete, the core columns to about level 62
外伸桁架約每 8 至 10 層一道，深度為單層、雙層或三層~Outriggers occur about every 8 to 10 floors and are one, two or three storeys deep
塔樓下 380 支直徑 1.5 m 基樁，嵌入岩盤 15 至 33 m，筏基厚 3.0 至 4.7 m~380 piles of 1.5 m diameter under the tower are socketed 15 to 33 m into rock beneath a raft 3.0 to 4.7 m thick
試驗樁壓力試驗最大約 40.6 MN、拉拔試驗最大約 22 MN~Trial piles were tested to about 40.6 MN in compression and about 22 MN in pull-out
風力準則：約半年回歸期檢核舒適度、50 年檢核變位、100 年檢核強度~Wind criteria: about a half-year return period for comfort, 50 years for drift and 100 years for strength
2002 年 3 月 31 日規模 6.8 地震使 56 樓兩部塔吊墜落，五人罹難~The magnitude 6.8 earthquake of 31 March 2002 toppled two cranes from level 56, killing five people
共 61 部電梯，最高速度約 16.83 m/s~61 elevators with a top speed of about 16.83 m/s
2015 年蘇迪勒颱風時主擺錘擺幅約 100 cm~The main pendulum swung about 100 cm in Typhoon Soudelor in 2015

timeline.event: 台北金融大樓以 BOT 方式取得開發權，展開規劃設計~Taipei Financial Center wins the BOT development award and design begins
開工，塔樓基樁與五層地下室開挖展開~Construction starts with tower piling and the five-level basement excavation
3 月 31 日地震使施工中塔吊自 56 樓墜落，工程停工約三個月~The 31 March earthquake topples cranes from level 56 and work stops for about three months
鋼構與塔尖完成，結構達到 508 m 封頂~Steelwork and pinnacle are completed and the structure tops out at 508 m
完工啟用，保持世界最高建築紀錄至 2010 年~Completed and opened, remaining the world's tallest building until 2010
蘇迪勒颱風使主擺錘擺幅約 100 cm，創營運紀錄~Typhoon Soudelor swings the main pendulum about 100 cm, an operational record
